verdict.rationale: Riveter is a hosted AI enrichment and extraction API, so letting users choose the extraction model is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence describes configuring, swapping, or self-hosting the LLM backend. The local option (riveter-docs-10) is a locally run MCP connector that still uses Riveter's API key, not a local LLM backend, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug in a local or self-hosted LLM as the extraction backend instead of a cloud-only model
